market_headlines.title: RBI Monetary Policy: Sanjay Malhotra-led MPC raises FY27 growth projections to 6.7% despite Middle East crisis
market_headlines.summary: The Reserve Bank of India revised its FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7% amid the Middle East crisis, reflecting domestic growth confidence.

market_headlines.title: RBI MPC meeting: Repo rate maintained at 5.25%; 5 key highlights from August policy meeting
market_headlines.summary: The RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra-led Monetary Policy Committee decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.25% and maintain a ‘neutral’ stance in its August 2026 policy meeting.

market_headlines.title: Manipal Health IPO listing: Shares list at 11% premium over the IPO price
market_headlines.summary: Manipal Health shares debuted at  ₹652 apiece on the NSE and  ₹655 on the BSE, delivering listing gains of more than 11% to investors who were allotted shares in the IPO.
